description: This file defines the 'Meta' class, a core component for managing metadata of document objects within the MigraDoc library. It includes methods for getting, setting, and checking values and null states of document object properties, as well as managing value descriptors.

classes.name: Meta
classes.description: A sealed class that provides metadata management for document objects, including property access, null checks, and descriptor management.

methods.name: GetMeta
methods.description: Returns the Meta instance associated with a given DocumentObject.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property from a DocumentObject by name, supporting nested properties via dot notation.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a property on a DocumentObject by name, supporting nested properties.

methods.name: HasValue
methods.description: Checks if a property with the specified name exists in the metadata.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Sets a specified property of a DocumentObject to null.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks if a specified property or the entire DocumentObject is null.

methods.name: SetNull (overload)
methods.description: Sets all properties of a DocumentObject to null.

methods.name: IsNull (overload)
methods.description: Checks if all properties of a DocumentObject are null.

methods.name: this[string]
methods.description: Indexer to access ValueDescriptors by property name.

methods.name: HasName
methods.description: Checks if a value descriptor with the given name exists.
